title: Nine Candles of Sugar
subtitle: 饮食与营养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食与营养（生活与学习·饮食与营养）
meta: 主题语境：饮食与营养（生活与学习·饮食与营养）　|　核心词汇：cake　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 cake 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1949 my mother was sent to ice ① a cake she could not cut, and she said the cutting was the whole of the lesson. The ② cake, meaning the sponge and not the sugar, was nine inches wide and was carried by whoever came last; a cake, she said, is the only thing in a kitchen that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ cake in that kitchen had the same icing, and the ④ cake at the front, meaning the one the baker kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever iced properly. A cake, my grandmother said, is nine parts flour and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the flour is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ cake was the whole of the birthday, meaning the day it marked and not the sponge. The ⑥ cake, meaning the birthday and not any of that, is the only thing in a house that everybody shares and nobody questions; a cake, he said, is either something you ice or the only word that means both a sponge and a birthday. She said the birthday is the part they remember.

By 1965 the ⑦ cake had become a photograph in a report, and the report had become an argument about the icing. The ⑧ cake of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine candles and eleven years of icing; a cake, she said, is either the one at the front or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ cake I remember is the one at the front, which was shared in 1970 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ cake, my grandmother said in 1974, is the only thing that improves by being shared; every cake, she said, is a birthday that has agreed to look like a sponge. She said the birthday was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 蛋糕（指那块糕本身，与糖相对）
C. 固定搭配：ice a cake 给蛋糕抹糖霜
D. n. 蛋糕（指厨房里每一块）
E. n. 蛋糕（指前面那一块）
F. n. 蛋糕（抽象：它所标记的那个生日）
G. n. 那个生日（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a cake she could not cut
The cake, meaning the sponge and not the sugar
cake was the whole of the birthday
the cake had become a photograph in a report
The cake of the whole thing
A cake, my grandmother said in 1974

answers.why: ice a cake 意为“给蛋糕抹糖霜”，1949 年母亲被派去给一块她切不动的蛋糕抹糖霜。
cake 意为“蛋糕”，指那块糕本身而不是糖，宽九英寸，由最后走的人端走。
cake 指厨房里每一块蛋糕，每一块都是同样的糖霜。
cake 指前面那一块（面包师留的那一块），是唯一有人认真抹过糖霜的。
cake 意为“蛋糕”，抽象指它所标记的那个生日，父亲说 cake 就是那个生日的全部。
cake 为抽象用法，指那个生日本身，是屋子里人人都分、却没人质疑的东西。
cake 意为“蛋糕、糕饼”，到 1965 年这块 cake 成了报告里的一张照片。
cake 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九根蜡烛和十一年的抹糖霜。
cake 意为“蛋糕”，我记得的是前面那一块，1970 年被分着吃，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
cake 为抽象总称，祖母说蛋糕是唯一会因为被分着吃而变好的东西。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1949 年母亲被派去给一块她切不动的蛋糕抹糖霜，她说切开才是这堂课的全部。（ice a cake）
那块蛋糕，指的是那块糕本身而不是糖，宽九英寸，由最后走的人端走。（cake）
那个厨房里每一块蛋糕都是同样的糖霜。（cake）
前面那块蛋糕，指的是面包师留的那一块，是唯一有人认真抹过糖霜的。（cake）
父亲说 cake 就是那个生日的全部，指的是生日而不是那块糕。（cake）
1974 年祖母说，蛋糕是唯一会因为被分着吃而变好的东西。（cake）
answers: In 1949 my mother was sent to ice a cake she could not cut, and she said the cutting was the whole of the lesson.
The cake, meaning the sponge and not the sugar, was nine inches wide and was carried by whoever came last.
Every cake in that kitchen had the same icing.
The cake at the front, meaning the one the baker kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever iced properly.
My father said cake was the whole of the birthday, meaning the day it marked and not the sponge.
A cake, my grandmother said in 1974, is the only thing that improves by being shared.
